title: v0.2 Practice habit
description: Turn the trainer into a daily habit and show how far away "Is it working?" is: a streak that forgives a rest day, an opt-in daily email, an ETA in games and the training numbers that are already trustworthy.

title: v0.3 Trainer depth
description: Drills for the focuses that have none today: the opening-trap lines replayed from move 1, a clock budget for time trouble, and won positions played out against an opponent at your level.

title: v0.4 Self-host and benchmark
description: A speed scorecard for the pipeline in four stages, from one Stockfish thread to a month of Lichess games and a coach report, tracked release over release, and a stack that fits a laptop.

title: v0.5 More players
description: Lichess accounts and PGN files as game sources, the app in more than one language, and an app that works on a phone and with a screen reader.

title: v1.0 MVP
description: The first complete release, declared in its own ADR: a stranger can sign up, link chess.com, practise daily, see whether it works, and delete everything when they leave.
